messages:
Nia (Design): Proposal: add a 'Condensed axis' mode for narrow panels. Strip per-tick unit labels, show single unit header, and surface a compact spike badge instead of rescaling charts. Quick feedback?

Rahul (PM): Good for dense dashboards. Concern: could hide meaningful spikes. How do we detect and communicate them? :thinking_face:

Iris (Viz): Detection idea: robust z-score using median/MAD. Mark point as outlier if |(v - median)/MAD| > 4. Isolated blips get a tiny badge; >=3 consecutive outliers = sustained trend (show full axis).

Jon (Frontend): Implementation: chart.mode = "condensed" | "normal". In condensed show 2 ticks + unit header. Badge shows "+n spikes" and expands to full axis on click. Perf: render badges in WebGL layer.

Elena (A11y): Copy: use "Show detailed axis" for the control. Keyboard: toggle reveals full tick list as an accessible table. Screen reader announce: "3 notable spikes from 2026-05-01 14:00 to 14:05". Ensure badge isn't color-only.
